entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:1
segments: ¶Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to stink [and] ferment; [so] a little folly is weightier than wisdom [and] honour.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:2
segments: The heart of a wise [man] is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:3
segments: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his sense faileth [him], and he saith to every one [that] he is a fool.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:4
segments: ¶If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for quietness pacifieth great offences.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:5
segments: There is an evil that I have seen under the sun, as an error [that] proceedeth from the ruler:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:6
segments: folly is set in great dignities, but the rich sit in a low place.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:7
segments: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:8
segments: He that diggeth a pit falleth into it; and whoso breaketh down a hedge, a serpent biteth him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:9
segments: Whoso removeth stones is hurt therewith; he that cleaveth wood is endangered thereby.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:10
segments: If the iron be blunt, and one do not whet the edge, then must he apply more strength; but wisdom is profitable to give success.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:11
segments: If the serpent bite before enchantment, then the charmer hath no advantage.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:12
segments: ¶The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool swallow up himself.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:13
segments: The beginning of the words of his mouth is folly; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:14
segments: And the fool multiplieth words: [yet] man knoweth not what shall be; and what shall be after him, who will tell him?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:15
segments: The labour of fools wearieth them, because they know not how to go to the city.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:16
segments: ¶Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:17
segments: Happy art thou, O land, when thy king is a son of nobles, and thy princes eat in [due] season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:18
segments: By much sloth fulness the framework falleth in; and through idleness of the hands the house drippeth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:19
segments: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh life merry; but money answereth everything.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:20
segments: Curse not the king, no, not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for the bird of the air will carry the voice, and that which hath wings will tell the matter.
